title: Roasted Garlic Potatoes
category: sides

cookTime: 40 min
servings: "6"
tags: [potatoes, roast, weeknight, sample]
notes: Sample starter recipe. Smash a few on the pan at the end for extra crisp.
---

## Ingredients

- 2 1/2 lbs baby potatoes, halved
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp kosher salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1 tsp paprika
- 6 garlic cloves, smashed
- 2 tbsp chopped rosemary or thyme
- Flaky salt, to finish

## Steps

1. Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with oil, salt, pepper, paprika, garlic, and herbs.
2. Spread on a sheet, cut side down. Roast 35 to 40 minutes until deep gold.
3. Finish with flaky salt. Serve hot.
